name: Vision & Biometrics
description: Visual perception: face recognition, head pose, gaze estimation, person tracking, and spatial presence.
capabilities: Real-time face recognition and owner verification
3D head pose and gaze attention tracking

help.NUXIVA_LIVENESS: With a webcam without infrared the face cannot be confirmed as live, so in the report-only and strict modes the display also asks for your voice before showing personal data. Turning the check off accepts a recognized face alone, but a photo could then open the widgets.
